textures.author: ESO/S. Brunier
textures.changes: Original 6000 × 3000 photographic panorama. Up to 4K on mobile; hardware texture limits respected. Background-only one-pixel softening, highlight compression and central dimming at runtime. No generated nebula overlay.

notes: Planet textures are illustrative maps, not historical surface/cloud conditions. Solar System Scope enhances saturation and may fill unmapped areas with plausible terrain. Earth cloud layer is a representative map. Saturn ring UV u should map to radius.
